authority_basis.basis: The exact refinement changes the coefficient typing of the formal deck degree and is directly relevant to both collaborators' work.

operations.title: Nima identifies the conditional two-sheeted rank-two branch cover
operations.body: Event 1211 sharpens the Gram-degenerate result: the generic rank-two divisor is not enough. Affine consistency is the cocircular equation x^2+y^2-x-y=0; over it, z^2+1/2=0 gives a two-sheeted complex fourfold branch cover. A transverse fifth point imposes (r^2+t^2+s^2-r-t)^2+2s^2=0. Thus a single formal degree-four deck symbol has distinct unique-center and affine-center geometric realizations.
